sense_en: The one unfolding: all change taken together as one unfolding (`World.run_world`)
not_carried_en: Not Xunzi's ontological sense of the two qi of yin and yang; takes only all changes as one unfolding; the noun sense, the unfolding of the whole, is this edition's convention. In English, not: a thing that unfolds beneath its changes (no substrate), a plan carried out by someone, nor the mathematical unfolding of a singularity

sense_en: Becoming: relations forming, persisting, transforming, degenerating and dissolving
not_carried_en: Not the Yizhuan sense tied to divining fortune and misfortune; generation alone means generation (opposed to degeneration), not the whole of change. In English, not: a coming-into-being out of nothing, a metaphysical principle of Becoming opposed to Being, nor development toward an end

sense_en: A relatum: what the unfolding relates
not_carried_en: A relatum is only a term of relations, not an entity prior to relations. In English, not: a thing, object or substance existing before its relations, nor a passive object acted on

sense_en: Formation: the role of a relatum that depends on and draws from others
not_carried_en: Paired with condition: the two are two roles of one and the same relatum. In English, not: something made by a maker, a shape, nor a geological or military formation

sense_en: Condition: a relatum in the role of what others depend on
not_carried_en: Names only what is depended on at a single step; that a condition itself depends means one relatum holds both roles. In English, not: a precondition imposed from outside, a state of health (in good condition), nor a stipulation in a contract

sense_en: Configuration: what the unfolding is at a step, how it relates
not_carried_en: Takes Xunzi's distinction of configuration from identity: the configuration is how it is at a step, identity is what is recognized as the same across steps. In English, not: an arrangement of pre-given parts, a setting chosen by someone, nor a software configuration

sense_en: Move: what a law leaves open at a step; applied to a configuration it takes it to another (`withMove` reads the move into the configuration)
not_carried_en: The earlier reading of the move as a possible displacement is withdrawn; not the metaphysical sense of motion opposed to rest. In English, not: an act chosen by a player or agent, a strategy, nor a change of residence

sense_en: Step: the shared index of natural-number steps
not_carried_en: Only a discrete shared index; the sense of time is named separately (time). In English, not: a walker's stride, a stage in a procedure someone follows, nor a unit of physical time

sense_en: Run: an infinite actual execution of a process; the one base
not_carried_en: Takes "a way is made by walking it": the law shown is formed by the run; not the Five Phases, not virtuous conduct. In English, not: a run that someone performs, a race, nor a run of luck

sense_en: Process: admissible changes, the move read within the configuration
not_carried_en: Shares with becoming the sense of change but at another level (becoming is the whole unfolding). In English, not: a procedure carried out by an agent, a legal process, nor an operating-system process

sense_en: Frame: a process with the claims each configuration realizes
not_carried_en: Carries no divination; the word is not set up as a general name for relation (each relation has its own name). In English, not: a picture frame or container, a framing chosen by an observer, nor a reference frame of physics

sense_en: Claim: what a configuration realizes, which can hold or not hold
not_carried_en: In English, not: an assertion someone makes, a claim of right or ownership, nor a demand

sense_en: World: a type of relata with a flow and a web of dependence; a run of a process that admits every step
not_carried_en: Not the cosmos as a substance; the Mohist spatial sense (extending over different places) is not taken, and the world is not set against duration. In English, not: the planet, a social world, nor a possible world of modal logic standing apart from the run

sense_en: Persisting through change
not_carried_en: The spine has no single law of persistence: a whole persists through the arising of its parts, a pattern through passing on; Sunzi's sense of a prolonged campaign is not taken. In English, not: endurance as effort, nor a substance enduring beneath change

sense_en: View: the common name of process, frame and world
not_carried_en: Names only the view on which a reading acts; not the act of looking or observing (observation has its own name). In English, not: an observer's opinion or point of view, nor a database view

sense_en: Reading: an interpretation with its standing; an amount read off what makes it up
not_carried_en: Readings are labelled as AI readings; not reciting a text. In English, not: a reader's act or preference, nor a reading taken by an instrument's operator

sense_en: The whole: everything in the one unfolding; counted as the rest, it is one relatum
not_carried_en: Takes the Mohist whole; Mozi's universal 兼 (impartial care) is a separate entry; alone it names everything of the unfolding (`World.withRest`); a whole whose parts a predicate gives is `Web.Whole`. In English, not: a totality standing over its parts, an organism or system with a will, nor a set containing things

sense_en: Part
not_carried_en: Mohist sense: a part is a share of a whole; not the essence/function sense of a root (that pairing is a separate entry and appears only in quotations). In English, not: a component existing before its relations, a role in a play, nor a party to a dispute

sense_en: The rest of the whole, read as one relatum
not_carried_en: The rest never acts; replaces the earlier name 大块. In English, not: an arithmetic remainder, nor an environment that acts on something

sense_en: Space: the type of worlds represented
not_carried_en: In English, not: physical or geometric space, nor a container that worlds sit in

sense_en: Dependence: what a formation requires and how much, given as thresholds
not_carried_en: Dependence is a relational predicate, not a thing. In English, not: reliance as trust, addiction, nor statistical dependence

sense_en: Web of dependence: holds levels, activity, requirements, needs and draws
not_carried_en: Stands beside flow and differs from it. In English, not: the World Wide Web, nor a net that catches

sense_en: Meets: a single requirement of a dependence is met by a level (need at most level)
not_carried_en: Names only one requirement met; every requirement met is admission; enough is meeting and stopping; not the cultivated sense of contentment (knowing what is enough). In English, not: satisfaction of a desire, nor meeting a person

sense_en: Support, admission: the levels meet every requirement of a formation at a step
not_carried_en: Of spatial containing only the relational form (levels and requirements) is taken; the virtue of tolerance is not carried; the generative space (what the levels admit) is a convention. In English, not: admission granted by a gatekeeper, a confession, nor holding in a vessel

sense_en: Draws: a formation draws from a condition
not_carried_en: A relational name (Wang Bi: 資 is taking); the sense of wealth and goods is not taken. In English, not: drawing a picture, a draw in a game, nor taking by decision

sense_en: Lives on
not_carried_en: In English, not: eating or nourishment by choice, nor being alive

sense_en: Interacts: two sides related symmetrically through a condition (`Web.Interacts`)
not_carried_en: One sense only; not isomorphic with the meeting of hexagrams (named separately); the 交 of the Tai commentary is read as conveying. In English, not: a conversation or social interaction, nor an exchange agreed between parties

sense_en: Mutual dependence
not_carried_en: In English, not: reciprocal obligation, nor a contract between parties

sense_en: Kept: a satisfied dependence is still satisfied across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with broken. In English, not: held by a keeper, nor preserved by effort

sense_en: Broken: a satisfied dependence is no longer satisfied across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with kept; same as the 絶 of degenerative (cut off); the senses of crossing a river and of exhaustion are not taken. In English, not: damaged or out of order, nor a broken promise

sense_en: Forms: a dependence appears across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with dissolves. In English, not: a shape, a form to fill in, nor something formed by a maker

sense_en: Dissolves: a dependence disappears across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with forms. In English, not: dissolving in a solvent, nor dissolution by a decision

sense_en: Coextinct: ended together with what one depends on, along a chain of dependence
not_carried_en: A new name: not the pre-Qin sense of both being lost; a line of the Shiguo gives the structure of perishing along with what one depends on. In English, not: the death of organisms beyond the stated chain, nor ecological coextinction as a field term beyond this structure

sense_en: Reserve: an amount carried (`Web.Carries`)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a stock set aside by someone for later, financial reserves, nor reticence

sense_en: Self-bearing: a relatum, while active, depends with positive need on its own level
not_carried_en: Replaces 自待; it depends on how conditions are labelled (`Mutualism.apart_relabelled`) and is not an independent property; no pre-Qin citation is set up. In English, not: self-sufficiency, autonomy or self-support by effort, nor a self as a substance

sense_en: Cut: a region that no formed relation leaves (`Flow.Cut`)
not_carried_en: Replaces 不交, so that interacts has one sense only. In English, not: an act of cutting by someone, a share of proceeds, nor a weighted minimum cut

sense_en: Necessary condition: without it, certainly not so
not_carried_en: Mohist dialectic; its structure is in `Web.Dependent` and the witness of `Hibernation.readings`. In English, not: a cause acting as an agent, nor a minor reason

sense_en: Necessary and sufficient condition
not_carried_en: Mohist dialectic; it has no anchor on the spine yet. In English, not: a cause acting as an agent, nor a major reason

sense_en: Makes a difference: the proviso of a break of dependence
not_carried_en: A compound; the pre-Qin sense of having strength is not taken; the proviso structure of "but for Guan Zhong" (微) is a comparison. In English, not: force, power or effort, nor making a difference by choice

sense_en: The difference made together
not_carried_en: Paired with makes a difference. In English, not: cooperation by agreement, nor joint effort

sense_en: Arising: activity starts across a step
not_carried_en: Takes Laozi 16 "arise together"; generation is not used (generation names only generation). In English, not: an uprising, nor arising from a ground or source

sense_en: Ceasing: activity stops across a step
not_carried_en: Names only ceasing; the Mohist line on completion and loss is only side evidence. In English, not: a decision to stop, nor death

sense_en: Comes to hold: a specification goes from not holding to holding across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with ceases to be; the same as the 成 of generative and of lock-in (coming to completion). In English, not: a thing coming into existence out of nothing, nor creation by a maker

sense_en: Ceases to hold: a specification goes from holding to not holding across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with comes to be. In English, not: a thing passing out of existence, nor destruction by someone

sense_en: Comes to stand as a condition: a condition's level goes from zero to positive across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with ceases to stand; only the reading with a level is taken; not the ontological sense of qi gathering; the forming of relations among components is named forms. Distance: the word means many things gathering, the name says only whether one condition has a level. In English, not: standing up, a stance taken, nor standing in law

sense_en: No longer stands as a condition: a condition's level goes from positive to zero across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with comes to stand; only the reading with a level is taken; dissolving of relations is named dissolves, and the 散 of "dispersing makes a beginning" is read as split. In English, not: falling down, nor giving up a position

sense_en: Keep pace: arisings and ceasings differ by at most the number of members
not_carried_en: In English, not: running alongside a rival, nor keeping up by effort

sense_en: Census balance over a stretch
not_carried_en: Here 息 means growing, unlike the 息 of unceasing (stopping); only as a compound; distinct from the waxing and waning ring of the twelve hexagrams. In English, not: equilibrium of forces, nor a balanced budget

sense_en: Census: a list of what holds at each step, each once
not_carried_en: Named apart from count. In English, not: a government count of persons

sense_en: Count: exists exactly where what it counts is decided
not_carried_en: Only counting; not fixed fate or allotted destiny. In English, not: a nobleman, nor counting as mattering

sense_en: Lists once exactly where sameness is decided
not_carried_en: Xunzi's 定數 is verb and object (fix the count); takes only that sameness of the real is fixed before counting; no sense of fate. In English, not: a list made by someone, nor a fixed sum or fate

sense_en: Unceasing: arising recurs without end
not_carried_en: The 息 here (stopping) differs from 息 as growing (in census balance and in Mencius); compare `Recycle.closed_unceasing` (unceasing without continuing generation). In English, not: eternal, effort without rest, nor perpetual motion

sense_en: Coming to rest: from some step on nothing arises
not_carried_en: Names only stopping; the Mohist "rest takes duration" (a pause) is not taken. In English, not: relaxation, nor a resting state someone chooses

sense_en: Stillness: what holds at once; a configuration the law leaves unchanged
not_carried_en: Stillness is not stopping (kept apart from coming to rest); not the cultivated sense of abiding in stillness. In English, not: quiet, calm of mind, nor absence of motion of a body

sense_en: Transformation: the configuration changes while identity is not divided
not_carried_en: Xunzi's definition in Rectifying Names: the configuration changes (not alike) and the continuation is unbroken. In English, not: metamorphosis by design, conversion of one substance into another, nor a mathematical transformation

sense_en: Two names, one referent within a step: the correspondence a re-identification gives at each step
not_carried_en: Mohist; renaming requires sameness at every step, which the text lacks; "killing a dog is not killing a hound" runs the other way: renaming keeps values only for readings defined by relations. In English, not: reference made by a speaker, nor identification by an observer

sense_en: Continuation: a formation continues one before it; identity across steps
not_carried_en: Xunzi's one real is continuation (the configuration changes, the real is not divided); the sense of lengthening the short is not taken. In English, not: a sequel, a substance persisting beneath change, nor continuing by decision

sense_en: The continuation relation itself (the relation on which `Web.Continues` rests)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a family line, nor a relation kept up by someone

sense_en: Continuity: a formation that stays active across a step keeps its name
not_carried_en: Mohist "with gap / without gap". In English, not: continuity of a function in analysis, nor continuity of an institution

sense_en: Succession: supply from sources that follow one another
not_carried_en: Not anchored on `KeepsTenure`; inheritance is named separately; the Zhongyong sense of continuing an aim is left as a gap. In English, not: succession to an office or throne, nor inheritance of property

sense_en: Hibernation: dormancy in which something is held
not_carried_en: Dormancy in which nothing is held (`Dormancy`) is its contrast. In English, not: the winter sleep of animals only, nor a computer mode

sense_en: Holds, persists: holding at one step (`Web.Holds`)
not_carried_en: Persisting at a step; persisting across steps is persistence through change. In English, not: endurance as effort, nor a substance that remains

sense_en: Split (`Web.NoSplit`)
not_carried_en: Replaces 分, so that 分 gives only footprints. In English, not: a division decided by members, nor a split in a group

sense_en: Merge of formations (`Web.NoMerge`)
not_carried_en: Replaces 并 (one form with 並 in simplified script); kept apart from the confluence of configurations. In English, not: a merger of companies, nor joining by agreement

sense_en: Flow: what each formation takes from and gives to each condition across a step
not_carried_en: Flow is `Flow`, not the web; the sense of excess and dissipation is not taken. In English, not: a fluid, a stream someone directs, nor a psychological state of flow

sense_en: Uptake: what is taken
not_carried_en: In English, not: understanding (quick on the uptake), nor absorption by a consumer

sense_en: Replenishment: what is given
not_carried_en: In English, not: restocking by a supplier, nor refilling by someone

sense_en: One exchange: a taking and a giving
not_carried_en: In English, not: trade between parties, a bargain, nor a gift

sense_en: Takers: the formations that take from the family at a step
not_carried_en: In English, not: buyers or grabbers, nor those who choose to take

sense_en: Balance: every change of a level is exactly what is taken and given
not_carried_en: Takes only the equation of a level scale: the level after the step plus all taken equals the level before plus all given; Xunzi's scale and standard (the way as the right weight, choosing fortune) is not carried; the gain and loss of one trade share the form but are not borrowed; the 衡 of judgment in Dispelling Obsession and the Mohist statics of the beam are not taken; balance is a supposition of a world, not a law. In English, not: equilibrium (a state of rest), fairness, nor an account balance

sense_en: Dissipation: each taker gives back at least one unit less than it takes on a closed family
not_carried_en: The pre-Qin sense is disorder and exhaustion; dissipation is an extended sense. In English, not: dissolute living, nor thermodynamic dissipation beyond the stated inequality

sense_en: Least loss: the least amount
not_carried_en: Mohist; kept apart from seed; the Mohist 端 is an indivisible point, the spine's a lower bound on loss; they coincide only in whole-number amounts. In English, not: loss to an owner, nor the least-action principle of physics

sense_en: Archimedean amounts
not_carried_en: An AI strong reading: the text speaks of accumulating, read as Archimedean amounts; the contrary witness is `Layered.not_archimedean`. In English, not: accumulation by effort, nor anything of Archimedes beyond the property of amounts

sense_en: Conveying
not_carried_en: In English, not: transport by a carrier, nor communicating a meaning

sense_en: Fed from beyond: something is conveyed into a member of a family from outside it
not_carried_en: In English, not: feeding by a keeper, nor a supply from a transcendent source

sense_en: Drawing in
not_carried_en: Equivalent to fed from beyond where equality is decidable (`Flow.inward_iff_not_fed`). In English, not: attracting by will, nor drawing a picture

sense_en: More without end
not_carried_en: Here 已 has the sense of ceasing. In English, not: an actual completed infinity, nor growth

sense_en: Depletion: a fall
not_carried_en: The Mohist definition of 損 gives only a part withheld; paired with gain. In English, not: exhaustion to nothing, nor a loss to an owner

sense_en: Closed: a family exchanges with nothing outside it across a step
not_carried_en: Replaces 闭关, so that 閉 names only an absorbing region. In English, not: shut by someone, a closed set of topology, nor a closed system beyond the step

sense_en: Enclosed around
not_carried_en: In English, not: fenced by an owner, nor a container

sense_en: Openness: exchange beyond every finite family
not_carried_en: Corresponds only to the mark 未 of the earlier 开 (the others are in the comparison table); anchored only on `arising_opens`; the open of `Seeking.more_needs_open` is another structure; openness is a property of a world, not an act: not from some step on is every step closed on some finite family; opening a passage of a part is named opening; Laozi's values of opening and closing are not carried. In English, not: open-mindedness, an open set, nor public access

sense_en: Renewing: every condition taken part in keeps supporting every dependent
not_carried_en: A class of runs; the Yizhuan 恆 is read as persistence. In English, not: repair by someone, nor renewal of a contract or subscription

sense_en: Return of a configuration: a configuration had again
not_carried_en: Names only a configuration had again. In English, not: going home, nor a financial return

sense_en: Return bound: an upper bound on the steps to a return
not_carried_en: Read qi (a time limit); only an upper bound; the exact number of steps is not so named. In English, not: a deadline set by someone, nor a period of oscillation

sense_en: Merge of courses: two courses go on as one (`Law.Merges`)
not_carried_en: Wang Bi's single-centre sense and the lossless return of the nine sentences are not taken. In English, not: a meeting of rivers only, nor the Church-Rosser confluence of rewriting

sense_en: Kept history: a law carried with its history (`Law.withHistory`)
not_carried_en: Accumulation of amounts is not taken. In English, not: memory of a mind, nor an archive someone keeps

sense_en: Undermining
not_carried_en: The verdicts of the text (misfortune, disregard of the right), the social sense of exploitation and the order from below are not taken. In English, not: sabotage by intent, nor digging

sense_en: Generation in the whole and its continuing on; its direction is compared by widening
not_carried_en: Not Laozi 50's clinging to life (the thickness of living); not the predicate living. In English, not: life as an organism, nor creation by a creator

sense_en: Generation, opposed to degeneration
not_carried_en: Names only generation: the history of levels widens the history with the part withheld; the wider senses of the word (appearing, being born, producing successors, being alive) have other names here (arising, comes to be, offspring, living); not every new appearance is generation; the value sense of "the great virtue of heaven and earth is generation" is not carried. In English, not: reproduction, a generation of people, production by a maker, nor generation in grammar or AI

sense_en: Generative: where a part widens
not_carried_en: In English, not: any new organization (generation and degeneration do not overlap), nor generative in AI or linguistics

sense_en: Degenerative
not_carried_en: Does not include permanence; what cannot be had again is lock-in. In English, not: moral degeneracy, nor a medical degeneration

sense_en: The generative space: what the levels admit
not_carried_en: In English, not: a physical space, nor a space of options someone chooses from

sense_en: Includes
not_carried_en: In English, not: membership in a club, nor containing as a vessel

sense_en: Exceeds
not_carried_en: Carries no better or worse: only admitting at some step what the other does not. In English, not: surpassing in merit, nor excess as too much

sense_en: Widens
not_carried_en: Names only the widening order and does not carry "better"; ordering has another name. In English, not: broadening by effort, nor growth in size

sense_en: Narrows
not_carried_en: In English, not: restricting by decision, nor shrinking in size

sense_en: Keeps the same: mutual inclusion
not_carried_en: In English, not: preserving by effort, nor conservatism

sense_en: A part withheld
not_carried_en: Mohist. In English, not: withholding by someone, nor a reserved share

sense_en: Margin
not_carried_en: The word 余 appears only in compounds: rest of the whole, margin and what is lost borrow nothing from one another. In English, not: a profit margin, nor a page margin

sense_en: Closing off: the closing of a part needs a net draw
not_carried_en: The quoted source speaks of alternation in time, kept as a comparison. In English, not: shutting by someone, nor the closing of a loop (named closing)

sense_en: Opening: the opening of a part needs a net giving
not_carried_en: The text keeps the form 闢 so as not to collide with 辟. In English, not: an opportunity, nor opening by someone

sense_en: Novelty: from some step on every configuration differs from all before
not_carried_en: Names only the new; not Zhu Xi's virtue of renewing oneself. In English, not: originality valued, nor a novelty item

sense_en: Gain: a family's stock rises across a step
not_carried_en: Paired with depletion; the senses of increasing something and of being helpful are not taken. In English, not: profit, an advantage to someone, nor amplifier gain

sense_en: Absorbing region: a region a law never leaves (an invariant of the process)
not_carried_en: Under a determined law the same as an invariant (`Law.absorbing_iff_invariant`); carries no negative value; a family exchanging with nothing outside is named closed; the absorbing region requires nothing to enter it, unlike a shut door that blocks both ways; Laozi's praise of closing is not carried. In English, not: a sponge, nor a region someone confines

sense_en: Lock-in: what is drawn in never comes back
not_carried_en: In English, not: locking by someone, nor vendor lock-in as a market practice

sense_en: Keeping at a juncture: the steps after which a configuration can still be had
not_carried_en: In English, not: guarding by a keeper, nor ownership

sense_en: Juncture: a configuration with a step after which a given configuration can still be had and one after which it cannot
not_carried_en: The 節如發機 line gives only the irrecoverable release of a trigger; Zhuangzi's 機 as origin and the Daxue's pivot of action are not taken. In English, not: a crisis for a decider, nor an anatomical joint

sense_en: Perturbation re-absorbed: only states perturbed are drawn back
not_carried_en: Replaces the structural sense of 稳 and 元闭 (kept only in the comparison table); carries no return to a prior root or undivided origin (Laozi 28, Wang Bi on 16); Laozi 16 speaks of returning to the root, not of perturbation, kept as a comparison; closed capture is named separately. In English, not: stability as a designed goal of control, nor absorption by a sponge

sense_en: Invariant: a property kept at every step
not_carried_en: Kept apart from persistence through change. In English, not: constancy as a virtue, nor the eternal

sense_en: Alike, bisimulation
not_carried_en: Mohist. In English, not: similar in appearance, nor identical

sense_en: Lumping: a reading and the classes it divides into
not_carried_en: Mohist dialectic; `Learning.Lumped` is read "the same by class". In English, not: a natural kind or class essence, nor a classifier's choice

sense_en: Generalization through lumping
not_carried_en: In English, not: a generalization made by a learner, nor a vague statement

sense_en: Modelling the laws of structure and change: a lumping that carries a law
not_carried_en: Every such lumping is a lumping, not every lumping is one; does not carry "principle before qi"; pre-Qin gives division, Wei-Jin commentary gives change; carrying a law is a condition the theory adds; it is not pattern itself, and reading it off pattern holds in one sense only. In English, not: a principle as a substance or ground, nor reason as a faculty

sense_en: Law: a determined process, read off the history it governs
not_carried_en: The Mohist 法 is the standard by which a thing is so; naming law so is an AI extension; Mencius' "where there are things there are rules" is a comparison; not Legalist decrees, not the Buddhist dharma. In English, not: legislation, a law-giver, nor a law of nature imposed from outside

sense_en: Law shown: a history is the least law of its run
not_carried_en: Takes Wang Bi: the law follows what is so; nature is not taken as an origin. In English, not: nature, nor a law displayed by someone

sense_en: Basin
not_carried_en: Only the sense of a basin; positional force in military writing is an entry; shown only on the mutual-hexagram law; a general partition is a gap; potential, stored force, battle array and imposed circumstance are not taken. In English, not: a river basin, nor potential energy

sense_en: Drawn into
not_carried_en: Possibly and necessarily drawn into are composed with "possibly" and "necessarily". In English, not: attracted by appeal, nor pulled by someone

sense_en: Attractor
not_carried_en: In English, not: something attractive by appeal, nor a strange attractor beyond the definition

sense_en: Gluing of contexts: contexts glue exactly where they agree on overlaps
not_carried_en: Zhongyong; `Law.Commutes` is not named by it. In English, not: adhesive, nor agreement between parties

sense_en: Undecided
not_carried_en: 未 only as a function word. In English, not: a decider's hesitation

sense_en: Parity
not_carried_en: In English, not: equality of standing between parties, nor exchange-rate parity

sense_en: Contradiction in a parity system
not_carried_en: In English, not: a quarrel, nor a dialectical contradiction that drives change

sense_en: A formation's own further course, resolved through the lumping its couplings make
not_carried_en: Adopted; the sense of registering is removed; the sense of remembering (seeing much and keeping it in mind) belongs to prefix; it rests on the same lumping of `SelectsThrough` as selection through couplings but names something else. In English, not: knowing, consciousness or cognition of a mind, nor recognition by an observer

sense_en: Course prefix: the values of a course before some step, latest first
not_carried_en: Names only the earlier segment of a course; the readings "from here on" and "not holding on to its past" are not taken; kept history has its own name; the sense of a record is removed; the common sense of going away, and the alternation of going and coming, are not named by it. In English, not: the past held in memory, nor a prefix of a word

sense_en: Retrodiction: reading back
not_carried_en: In English, not: recollection by a mind, nor a forecaster looking back

sense_en: Testing (`Web.Excludes`)
not_carried_en: In English, not: an examination set by an examiner, nor a medical test

sense_en: Verification
not_carried_en: In English, not: checking by an auditor, nor confirmation of a belief

sense_en: Experiment
not_carried_en: In English, not: a laboratory procedure only, nor trying something out at will

sense_en: Control: a given model that what differs between two occasions is irrelevant to the change
not_carried_en: A control is given, not a proven absence of difference (alike); `Confound.confounded` is its boundary. In English, not: command or domination, nor the controller of control theory

sense_en: Sensitivity: a formation's exchange at some step is not fixed by the other conditions' levels up to that step alone
not_carried_en: Asks only whether, how much is coupling strength; it gives no witness of two histories (differing exchange where only one level differs is named responds to); for finite readings it is the least coupling the law reads (`least_coupling`), not own course through couplings; inspecting many clues is named testing or verification; inspecting, harsh scrutiny, discernment of the mind and supervision are not taken. In English, not: emotional sensitivity, a sensor or observer, nor the sensitivity rate of a test

sense_en: Learnable
not_carried_en: In English, not: learned by the effort of a learner, nor knowable by a knower

sense_en: Horizon
not_carried_en: `prefix_does_not_decide` is an example. In English, not: the visible horizon, nor an event horizon

sense_en: Training
not_carried_en: In English, not: teaching by a teacher, nor habit

sense_en: Extrapolation by elimination
not_carried_en: The moral sense of a fault (correcting it when at fault) is not taken. In English, not: elimination of rivals, nor guessing

sense_en: Accords / misses: no miss at any value given out (giving out no value also accords)
not_carried_en: Han Feizi's "the four signs accord" is not cited for this name. In English, not: an agreement between parties, nor a treaty

sense_en: Lasso: a course that repeats every fixed number of steps from some step on
not_carried_en: A lasso is a property of a course; a loop is a circuit of couplings; return is the return of a configuration; a course has finitely many states exactly where it is a lasso. In English, not: a rope, nor catching something

sense_en: Cross-checking with fallible witnesses
not_carried_en: Xunzi's 參 glossed as three is not taken. In English, not: checking by an auditor, nor cross-examination

sense_en: Judgment process
not_carried_en: The evaluative sense of judging fortune and misfortune (Xici) is not taken. In English, not: a judge or court, nor personal judgment

sense_en: Runs part
not_carried_en: In English, not: parting of company, nor a decision to separate

sense_en: Typicality by counting
not_carried_en: In English, not: what is usual by custom, nor a normal person

sense_en: Name
not_carried_en: Mohist. In English, not: a reputation, nor a personal name only

sense_en: A name in one-to-one correspondence within a step
not_carried_en: The sense of partiality of 私, already pre-Qin, is not taken. In English, not: a person's name, nor anything private

sense_en: A reading that divides nothing (the constant lumping)
not_carried_en: In English, not: nothing beyond the sense; the word has no agentive or substantival reading here

sense_en: Labels carry no relation
not_carried_en: Xunzi, Rectifying Names. In English, not: names being arbitrary by someone's will, nor labels owned by anyone

sense_en: Shared codes
not_carried_en: Adopted; reading convention as the order of hearing is the AI's structural reading; in Xunzi convention is subordinate to the king's making of names. In English, not: a social contract agreed by parties, nor a secret code

sense_en: Imposed code: a code imposed on the formations
not_carried_en: Carries no royal centre and does not include coining new names. In English, not: imposition by a ruler, nor a legal code

sense_en: A description that makes sense: it identifies exactly the configurations that are alike
not_carried_en: In English, not: meaning held by a mind, nor correctness decreed by an authority

sense_en: Holding across situations
not_carried_en: Takes only the structure of running through situations; the single central principle of "my way is threaded by one" is not taken. In English, not: social standing, nor a standing order

sense_en: Acquiring a code
not_carried_en: In English, not: knowledge possessed by a mind, nor purchase

sense_en: Coupling; couples into
not_carried_en: A relational predicate; the direction (condition into formation) is a convention of the users; Xunzi's "responds and is so of itself" supports the passive sense. In English, not: feeling, perception or sympathy, sexual coupling, nor a physical coupling constant

sense_en: Responds to
not_carried_en: Used alone only as responding; the relation between lines of a hexagram is named 相應. In English, not: a reply by a speaker, nor a deliberate answer

sense_en: Feeding closure
not_carried_en: Closures are named uniformly as regions: feeding, influence, reach, coupling and system closures. In English, not: feeding by a keeper, nor nourishment

sense_en: Influence closure
not_carried_en: In English, not: social influence, nor persuasion

sense_en: Reach closure
not_carried_en: In English, not: reaching out by an agent, nor range of a weapon

sense_en: Coupling closure
not_carried_en: In English, not: perception of a mind, nor closure of a mechanical coupling

sense_en: System closure
not_carried_en: In English, not: a social or political system, nor an organized whole with a purpose

sense_en: What a part reaches
not_carried_en: Reach of a single step. In English, not: reaching by effort, nor ambition

sense_en: Selection: any claim about level histories
not_carried_en: In English, not: choice by a chooser, nor natural selection beyond the claim

sense_en: Selection through couplings
not_carried_en: `Web.selects_alike_iff` is its defining equivalence (a law of definition). In English, not: choosing by a chooser who perceives

sense_en: The gap of a selection: what lies in the reach closure and not in the coupling closure
not_carried_en: Replaces 蔽 as the name of the limit. In English, not: ignorance of a mind, nor a bias

sense_en: Seeking locked onto a goal that cannot rest
not_carried_en: Adopted; differs from the first link of the twelve links of dependent origination; `rests_iff` is its boundary. In English, not: ignorance, delusion of a mind, nor desire

sense_en: Couplings joined to a selection that reach what support does not mark
not_carried_en: Adopted; the word means clear discernment and lucidity; this name takes only one structure of the Analects (slander that soaks in does not work): coupling reaches the rise of a level that support does not mark, and any positive rise then parts the two courses (`observed_raise_couples`); it is a narrow sense and does not include judging truth and falsity; "knowing the constant is clarity" corresponds to invariant and is not cited; kept apart from sensitive (the least coupling a law reads) and from coupling read early. In English, not: clarity or enlightenment of a mind, wisdom, nor illumination

sense_en: Pooled coupling
not_carried_en: Takes the sense of joining into a whole. In English, not: a pool of money, nor a coalition by agreement

sense_en: Capture through the rule: a rule read from the ratio of what it selects
not_carried_en: The ruler-minister framework is not taken. In English, not: seizing by an agent with intent, kidnapping, nor regulatory capture beyond this structure

sense_en: Pace: the speed at which a rule changes
not_carried_en: In English, not: a walking pace, nor a tempo someone sets

sense_en: A requested change must be an executable sequence: it completes exactly where it runs
not_carried_en: Includes here "the law does not execute itself". In English, not: completion by effort, nor a request granted by someone

sense_en: Loop: a chain of couplings back to where it started
not_carried_en: In English, not: a loop of rope, nor a program loop beyond the chain

sense_en: Closing of a loop: the loops formed by a step are the loops of the couplings acting before it
not_carried_en: In English, not: shutting by someone, nor closing a deal

sense_en: Feedback
not_carried_en: The sense of returning first appears in the commentary layer; the pre-Qin counterpart is Zengzi's "what goes out from you comes back to you". In English, not: comments given by a person, nor audio feedback

sense_en: Return map: the amount handed back to the start after the responses around a loop are composed
not_carried_en: The response of a single link uses responds to; requital and trade are not taken. In English, not: a map of a journey, nor a report

sense_en: Runaway through a loop
not_carried_en: The sense of runaway through a loop is a convention; the word means growing; the premise of `polynomial_iff_no_loop` is recorded. In English, not: escape by someone, nor a failure of a controller

sense_en: The break not read before it comes
not_carried_en: Laozi 64 gives only the sense of the word (no sign yet); the structure of its sentence is keeping before a juncture, kept as a comparison. In English, not: unforeseen by a forecaster, nor hidden by someone

sense_en: The break: a stock falls below the threshold and the law turns from not reading it to reading it
not_carried_en: Names only the break below a threshold; the Xici sense of being unable to go on, the Xugua sense of ending, and the Mohist spatial limit are not taken. In English, not: damage, nor a pause

sense_en: Frequency of a coupling
not_carried_en: A convention, low confidence; in ancient texts 頻數 is mostly adverbial. In English, not: a radio frequency, nor frequentist probability

sense_en: A coupling recurs
not_carried_en: 已 is ceasing; 不已 is not ceasing and recurring. In English, not: repetition by habit

sense_en: What a cut at some order leaves uncounted
not_carried_en: Replaces 余. In English, not: loss to an owner, nor a cut someone makes

sense_en: Coupling strength
not_carried_en: In English, not: force or power, nor gain of an amplifier

sense_en: Two-sided regulation
not_carried_en: Adopted; the Zhongyong context of feelings before arising and measured when arisen, and of norms, is not carried; only the structure is taken: opposite giving gives direction, the measure gives the bound, together the level settles at m; feelings, cultivation and timely mean are not carried. In English, not: moderation as a virtue, regulation by an authority, nor neutralization in chemistry

sense_en: The bound is exactly no overshoot: one step's total taking and giving does not carry the level past m
not_carried_en: Only the structure is taken; feelings and judgments of propriety are not carried; 節 is not set up as a name alone (restraint in use is named frugality, the trigger line belongs to juncture, measure as a judgment has no name). In English, not: restraint by self-control, nor propriety

sense_en: Overshoot
not_carried_en: In English, not: going too far by misjudgment, nor excess as a fault

sense_en: Responding to one side only (a one-sided premise, not regulation)
not_carried_en: `Regulation.OneSided` is an empty-flow witness; a one-sided law with exchange is a gap. In English, not: bias of a person

sense_en: Reading late
not_carried_en: Names only reading late (`Regulation.ReadsLate`); not reading in at all uses unread before the break or plain words. In English, not: lateness of a reader's attention

sense_en: Tolerance
not_carried_en: Names only tol at least 1; tol 0 is the law of waiting without memory. In English, not: forbearance as a virtue, nor permissiveness

sense_en: Restoring from every start
not_carried_en: Here 待 means meeting and responding, a sense other than dependence, only in this idiom. In English, not: restoration by a restorer, nor repair

sense_en: Keeps giving first: giving at every step, without regard to what is awaited
not_carried_en: In English, not: generosity, nor a gift

sense_en: Descent
not_carried_en: Direction: x descends from g, and g is what x descends from (the giver); offspring are written "those that descend from g"; descent follows coming to stand, not arising. In English, not: ancestry of a family, nor going down

sense_en: Inheritance: at the step at which x descends from g, what x depends on after the step g depended on before it
not_carried_en: From the Analects with variation; the main philosophical sense of the word, acting according to conditions, is named responds to and selection through couplings; it is not read as cause (necessary and sufficient conditions have their own names); only the sense of inheriting is taken. In English, not: inheritance of property, nor genetic inheritance beyond the stated relation

sense_en: Transmission
not_carried_en: Takes only the structure of inheriting with bounded requirements; the relay sense of 傳 has another name; 传 as a layer label is a text layer. In English, not: broadcasting, nor a gearbox

sense_en: Variation: the rise and fall of an offspring's amounts against its parent's
not_carried_en: Built differently from depletion and gain taken singly (a family's level change across a step); the Price equation is named the account of variation. In English, not: variety, nor statistical variance

sense_en: Evolution through descent: only supported formations have offspring; requirements passed on within the bound are selected within the bound
not_carried_en: This selection is by presence or absence of support, not selection through couplings. In English, not: progress, improvement, nor design

sense_en: Net giver
not_carried_en: In English, not: a donor by choice, nor a benefactor

sense_en: Model: the map itself (r : K -> V)
not_carried_en: The model of a selection is the map a selection goes through. In English, not: a mental model, an exemplar to imitate, nor a model of model theory

sense_en: Learning through others' actual responses
not_carried_en: The sense of checking against a reference ("the great craftsman takes his standard from it") and the Buddhist sense of grasping are not taken. In English, not: learning by a mind, nor imitation

sense_en: Collective
not_carried_en: The living together of the system closure, with the bound of footprints. In English, not: a society of persons, nor collectivism

sense_en: Exclusive footprints
not_carried_en: 分 gives only footprints (the footprint of a configuration is named footprint). In English, not: the print of a foot, a carbon footprint, nor a share or social role

sense_en: Joint plan
not_carried_en: Sunzi. In English, not: a plan devised by planners, nor an agreement

sense_en: On a condition, what a step takes is no more than what it gives
not_carried_en: Xunzi's original stands in a frame of rank and proportion and is not taken. In English, not: restraint by choice

sense_en: Race at a shared condition
not_carried_en: In English, not: a contest between rivals with wills, nor race as descent group

sense_en: Relative position: position against the family's total
not_carried_en: Names only position against the whole family's sum; the senses of fitting and proportion are not taken; grinding against one another is a comparison entry. In English, not: social standing, nor rank

sense_en: A condition every formation shares
not_carried_en: In English, not: shared misfortune, nor a common cause

sense_en: Mutual feeding
not_carried_en: Replaces 交相利; the value sense of benefit is not carried. In English, not: mutual benefit, nor trade

sense_en: What pooling adds
not_carried_en: In English, not: harmony as a virtue, nor a merger

sense_en: A pooling equal to that of one member
not_carried_en: Carries no ranking of the noble and the petty person. In English, not: conformity as a fault

sense_en: Giving after waiting, with memory
not_carried_en: The affirmative form is inferred back from the negative. In English, not: a grudge, nor resentment of a mind

sense_en: Giving after waiting, without memory
not_carried_en: In English, not: forgiveness as a virtue, nor forgetfulness of a mind

sense_en: Several conditions kept at once
not_carried_en: 兼 takes the sense of joining, the same character as the whole. In English, not: held together by someone

sense_en: Significance: the one supplied evaluative parameter
not_carried_en: Gazing, perceiving, valuing for use and caring for are not taken. In English, not: meaning of a sign, importance to someone, statistical significance, a grade, nor a valence

sense_en: Valuation
not_carried_en: In English, not: a price, nor an appraisal by someone

sense_en: Living
not_carried_en: Surviving and keeping alive are not taken; living is not continuing generation. In English, not: biological life only, nor making a living

sense_en: Living significance
not_carried_en: Replaces 仁 (仁 is a divergence entry). In English, not: the meaning of life, nor the worth of persons

sense_en: The continuation condition: stated, not asserted; it fixes scope and orders nothing
not_carried_en: Stated, not asserted; replaces 无弃. In English, not: a contractual condition, nor a relatum in the role of condition

sense_en: Standpoint
not_carried_en: Takes the sense of place and location for standpoint; the 方 of "just now living, just now dying", the arts, method and direction are not taken. In English, not: an observer's opinion or viewpoint, nor a side in a debate

sense_en: Center (of significance)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a self as a substance, an ego, nor a midpoint

sense_en: Own region
not_carried_en: In English, not: an owner, nor property

sense_en: Seed
not_carried_en: Replaces the seed sense of 端; the sense of growing of itself is not taken. In English, not: a plant seed only, nor a random seed

sense_en: Self-significance
not_carried_en: Replaces 自爱. In English, not: self-love, self-interest, nor self-esteem

sense_en: Relational neutrality
not_carried_en: Does not carry "always with the good". In English, not: indifference, nor impartiality of a judge

sense_en: Standpoint neutrality and standpoint invariance
not_carried_en: Autumn Floods; "raising the worthy without regard to origin" and "a people without direction" are not taken. In English, not: impartiality of a judge, nor having no opinion

sense_en: Neutral: for all
not_carried_en: Mohist; universal impartial care is a comparison entry. In English, not: an attitude of impartiality, nor chemical neutrality

sense_en: Bounded significance: significance within a region and none outside
not_carried_en: Mozi's partiality (别). In English, not: discrimination against persons

sense_en: The boundary of a self
not_carried_en: Qiwulun. In English, not: a self as a substance, nor a property line

sense_en: The presupposition
not_carried_en: In English, not: an assumption a speaker makes, nor a belief

sense_en: The step of invariance: the presupposition does not change with how the boundary is drawn
not_carried_en: Fixes scope only and orders nothing; selflessness is a divergence entry. In English, not: a step of a walker, nor a deliberate decision

sense_en: Positive relevance read from significance
not_carried_en: The content must be realized. In English, not: relevance to an interest, nor positivity as approval

sense_en: Practical judgment
not_carried_en: Names only weighing within a given whole by a given comparison; the total order of the balance (the right weight of all times) and permission of exceptions beyond the norm are not taken. In English, not: the verdict of a judge, nor power

sense_en: C, the widening comparison: widening is better; the only premise that ranks courses
not_carried_en: Stated, carrying "better" openly; every place that speaks of ranking cites it alone. In English, not: preference of a chooser, nor maximization

sense_en: Retains
not_carried_en: Agrees with `Web.Retains` only for exchanges where like is exchangeable for like; the Jing hexagram's "neither losing nor gaining" is a level not below its start (`Flow.level_kept`), the same words built differently, kept as a comparison. In English, not: keeping possession, nor hiring

sense_en: Adds
not_carried_en: Paired with retains. In English, not: gain to an owner

sense_en: J1, complete comparison
not_carried_en: The half on retained losses takes Laozi 79 ("settle a great grievance and some grievance remains") as its main evidence. In English, not: a comparison made by a judge

sense_en: J2, basic conditions first
not_carried_en: Mencius' small and great are layers (the worth of parts of the body), not amounts, unlike the small of accumulation within a kind; carries no rank of "not harming the noble by the base". In English, not: priority by rank, nor basic needs of persons only

sense_en: J3, bounded responsibility
not_carried_en: The Analects; the Mohist 任 (a scholar harms himself to benefit what he serves) is not taken. In English, not: legal liability, nor blame

sense_en: FR, finite responsiveness
not_carried_en: FR is a revisable commitment, not a law; within a kind no permanent lexical weighting is set. In English, not: responsiveness of a person, nor service

sense_en: Enough: rests exactly where the target is met
not_carried_en: In English, not: satiety, nor contentment

sense_en: Preemption
not_carried_en: Replaces 先占: it says only drawing before a dependence forms; the first anchor is a witness. In English, not: a preemptive strike, nor a legal right of first purchase

sense_en: What is stated and not asserted
not_carried_en: The continuation condition, the widening comparison, LPO as a named condition and the like; the local hypothesis of one law is written with "if" and is not so called. In English, not: a guess, nor something believed by someone

sense_en: A theorem without added premise
not_carried_en: One of the four kinds of standing. In English, not: a self-evident truth

sense_en: A theorem under the stated premises
not_carried_en: One of the four kinds of standing. In English, not: a hypothesis believed

sense_en: A checked statement (a theorem) and its check
not_carried_en: The 證 of the Mohist three-way division. In English, not: evidence in court, nor the strength of a spirit

sense_en: Open (not yet settled)
not_carried_en: In English, not: openness of a world, nor an open mind

sense_en: Derivation
not_carried_en: Mohist; the same as the 說 of the explanations (that by which it is made clear). In English, not: a derivative in calculus, nor origin of a word

sense_en: Counterexamples and countermodels
not_carried_en: In English, not: an objection by an opponent

sense_en: Decided: p or not p
not_carried_en: In English, not: a decision taken by someone

sense_en: Double negation (not not p)
not_carried_en: In English, not: proven true, nor beyond dispute by authority

sense_en: The law of excluded middle
not_carried_en: In English, not: a middle person excluded

sense_en: Weakly decided
not_carried_en: Holds only for one contradictory pair of claims; as a universal over every claim it is the weak excluded middle, a supposition. In English, not: a weak decision by someone

sense_en: LPO: every Boolean sequence is true somewhere or false everywhere
not_carried_en: The source is a comparison. In English, not: a knower who knows everything

sense_en: Agreement (one of the three relations to a source)
not_carried_en: In English, not: an agreement between parties, nor consent

sense_en: Scope: a source line holds within a stated scope (one of the three relations to a source)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a restriction imposed by an authority, nor the scope of an instrument

sense_en: Divergence (one of the three relations to a source)
not_carried_en: When quoting Yogacara the term is put in quotation marks with a note of its sense of the perceived aspect. In English, not: divergence of a series, nor a disagreement between persons

sense_en: The nondual method
not_carried_en: A method requirement with no Lean anchor; the sage-centred "illuminating it by heaven" is not carried. In English, not: a mystical non-duality, nor a doctrine that all is one

sense_en: Situation
not_carried_en: Xunzi, Youzuo; Wang Bi's "a hexagram is a time" names a configuration, kept as a comparison. In English, not: a person's predicament, nor a social situation

sense_en: The order of steps
not_carried_en: D43. In English, not: a command, nor a rank

sense_en: Place (of a line in a hexagram)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a social place or rank, nor a location in space

sense_en: Holding its place (a line of the right kind for its place)
not_carried_en: In English, not: knowing one's place, nor social propriety

sense_en: In phase: a line's firm or yielding value agrees with the parity of its place (`Hexagram.inPhase`)
not_carried_en: Names only in phase; holding its place is narrower than in phase; the sense of upright divination is not taken; the main senses of the word, rightness and correcting, belong to the layer of value and are not set up as names; correcting is the composition of two courses (rejoining), and a course without moves is only a comparison, not a standard. In English, not: a phase of matter, nor uprightness or correctness

sense_en: The central place
not_carried_en: In English, not: a central authority, nor the mean as a virtue

sense_en: Correspondence of lines (`Hexagram.opposed`)
not_carried_en: Responds to, used alone, means only responding. In English, not: letters exchanged, nor sympathy

sense_en: Adjacent lines
not_carried_en: A convention: names only lines adjacent and differing, without the sense of attaching to or siding with. In English, not: neighbourliness, nor allegiance

sense_en: The seam with yielding below and firm above (`Hexagram.rises`)
not_carried_en: Names only this seam (the technical sense in the Tuan and Xiao Xiang and in Wang Bi on line places); the common senses of receiving, carrying and succeeding have other names (couples into and bearing for receiving action; descent and inheritance for succession); the sense of the lower supporting the higher and of mutual support are not taken. In English, not: support given by someone, nor ascent

sense_en: Riding (of lines)
not_carried_en: The senses of taking advantage and of driving are not taken. In English, not: riding a horse, nor exploiting

sense_en: The sole differing line
not_carried_en: Replaces 上下應. In English, not: a lone person, nor a single line of text

sense_en: A rule changes by reading the configuration it is in
not_carried_en: Switching is an example. In English, not: a switch of mind, nor a decision to change policy

sense_en: Can go on (the run continues)
not_carried_en: Takes one structure only. In English, not: passing through, nor communication

sense_en: Line values (firm and yielding)
not_carried_en: Replaces yin and yang as the name of line values. In English, not: masculine and feminine, nor hard and soft as materials

sense_en: Contextual readings compose one world
not_carried_en: Qiwulun; readings each hold in their context and together make one world without first being merged into one. In English, not: a composition written by someone, nor relativism

sense_en: Active only when supported (`Web.Dependent` as a premise)
not_carried_en: Qiwulun; names only this premise; necessary condition takes it as anchor and has another witness. In English, not: a reliant person, nor a dependant in law or tax

sense_en: Embodied: active exactly where the level is positive
not_carried_en: Replaces naming embodiment by 體; takes only activity exactly where there is a level: a relatum's standing as a condition for others is its own activity; carries no sense of bodily form; shape and showing are named configuration and observation; the pre-Qin "having form" (having a body, measurable and divisible) is not cited, since remains have a body but are not active; the name is a convention. In English, not: having a body, incarnation, nor embodied cognition

sense_en: A dependence with positive requirement (`Web.Bearing`)
not_carried_en: In English, not: a compass bearing, a ball bearing, demeanour, nor carrying a burden by effort

sense_en: Ends: from some step on never active
not_carried_en: Names only ending without return; coextinct shares the sense; leaving a class (a claim going from holding to not holding across a step) is ceases to be; read on activity that is ceasing (a stop at one step), while ends is never active again from some step on; leaving a class is not ending. In English, not: death, nor an end as a goal

sense_en: Re-identification: the correspondence given at each step between two namings
not_carried_en: Follows the Chinese edition; co-reference within a step names only two names of one referent within a step. In English, not: recognizing a person again, nor identification by an observer

sense_en: Arises from nothing it continues: active after the step and continuing no formation active before
not_carried_en: In English, not: creation from nothing by a creator

sense_en: A pattern lasts through passing
not_carried_en: Yangshengzhu: the firewood are carriers that each end, the fire is a pattern passed on without end. In English, not: dying, nor handing over by someone

sense_en: A level rises
not_carried_en: Paired with falls. In English, not: promotion, nor rebellion

sense_en: A level falls
not_carried_en: Paired with rises. In English, not: moral fall, nor defeat

sense_en: Runs down: a step at which a family balances and dissipates and its total falls
not_carried_en: In English, not: disparaging someone, nor running someone over

sense_en: Conserving: what is given equals what is taken
not_carried_en: A fixed phrase. In English, not: conservation by a conservationist, nor conservatism

sense_en: Nothing from nothing (the first law): what is given is no more than what is taken
not_carried_en: A fixed phrase. In English, not: unprofitable, nor without benefit to someone

sense_en: Joint excess
not_carried_en: First proposed as 合取過與; 合取 is conjunction in logic and misleads. In English, not: greed, nor excess as a fault

sense_en: Renewers: the formations that give to the family at a step
not_carried_en: Read yu; 與者 alone is easily read as participants. In English, not: those who renew a contract

sense_en: Takes all that is given
not_carried_en: In English, not: seizing by greed, nor winning all

sense_en: Approaches rest without reaching it
not_carried_en: Kept apart from coming to rest. In English, not: striving that fails

sense_en: Exhaustion: a stock falls to zero
not_carried_en: Dazongshi. In English, not: tiredness, nor exhaustion of a person

sense_en: Every dependence is kept at every step (`Web.Renewed`, the condition layer of renewing)
not_carried_en: In English, not: restored by someone, nor a renewed contract

sense_en: Consuming: some dependent of a condition drawn on loses support for good
not_carried_en: Not the negation of renewing (`fluctuating_neither`). In English, not: eating, nor consumption by a consumer

sense_en: Restored: every dependence is met at some later step (not requiring that it was met before)
not_carried_en: Not named return, since restored does not require being met before; D49 names both return and restored 转, as the comparison table notes. In English, not: repair by a restorer

sense_en: Some dependence is never met again from some step on (`Web.Consumed`)
not_carried_en: Paired with restored. In English, not: eaten, nor used up by a consumer

sense_en: Met, then broken, and never met again (`Web.Lost`)
not_carried_en: Its break is broken (`Web.Broken`). In English, not: loss to an owner, nor being lost in space

sense_en: No finite prefix decides the class of a run
not_carried_en: Wang Bi on the Wenyan of Qian, quoting the Odes (Da Ya, Dang). In English, not: indecision of a decider

sense_en: Mixed: each admits at some step what the other does not
not_carried_en: First proposed as 各有所長, which first appears in the Tang (Zongmi) and carries evaluation. In English, not: confused, nor a blend of substances

sense_en: Threshold of rising: a level rises to a threshold and then a new coupling forms
not_carried_en: Mencius. In English, not: filling by someone, nor a tax threshold

sense_en: Same by class (Lumped pi g): g takes one value on each class of pi
not_carried_en: In English, not: social class, nor equality of persons

sense_en: A coupling to a level that is read early
not_carried_en: `observed_raise_couples` is one instance; anchored apart from coupling beyond support. In English, not: foresight of a mind, nor intuition

sense_en: Observation: a route of readings starting from what is observed (of length zero, direct witness; otherwise, passed on)
not_carried_en: The Mohist knowing by hearing (among hearing, explanation and personal experience) is only the kind through others. In English, not: an observer's act of looking, nor a remark

sense_en: Extrapolation
not_carried_en: Shuogua; Mozi's "knowing the coming by the past" has the structure of generalization through lumping and is cited there. In English, not: prophecy, nor guessing

sense_en: Silence: giving no value where it cannot be determined
not_carried_en: First proposed as 默; Xunzi's "silent and apt" is a rule of speech and is not taken. In English, not: silence of a speaker, nor keeping a secret

sense_en: Scope of an inquiry: the configurations a policy's actual executions reach
not_carried_en: Replaces one sense of horizon; first proposed as 所見; Zeyang. In English, not: the reach of an instrument, nor the remit of an authority

sense_en: Diagonal course: on it every value an extrapolation gives misses
not_carried_en: Follows the chapter on the Changes; yin-yang and spirit are not taken; renamed from diagonal sequence. In English, not: a diagonal line drawn

sense_en: Reads: the reader's code tells the sense entries apart and the two codes agree there
not_carried_en: Takes only understanding and reading out, without the sense of metaphor. In English, not: understanding by a mind, nor cryptographic decryption

sense_en: A code tells sense entries apart
not_carried_en: Kept apart from bounded significance. In English, not: discernment of a mind, nor discrimination against persons

sense_en: Resolution of sense entries: only one candidate sense entry remains
not_carried_en: Mohist. In English, not: a resolve of will, nor a resolution adopted by vote

sense_en: Response closure
not_carried_en: Dual of coupling closure (`Flow.withinResponse_iff_coupling`). In English, not: responsiveness of a person, nor outreach

sense_en: Selector: the formation through whose couplings a selection goes
not_carried_en: Formed like formation and takers. In English, not: a chooser, nor a switch someone sets

sense_en: The rule holds the result
not_carried_en: The line of Laozi 64 is an entry. In English, not: seizure by an agent, nor taking prisoners

sense_en: Where the reading itself is formed by the share, a change of the reading is absorbed too
not_carried_en: In English, not: a prisoner, nor a closed shop

sense_en: The reading step of a pace
not_carried_en: Xunzi, Wangzhi. In English, not: a reader's pause, nor a stage of a procedure

sense_en: A request is not a completion
not_carried_en: Mohist. In English, not: a disobeyed command

sense_en: Carried amount
not_carried_en: First proposed as 所致; pre-Qin 所致 mostly attributes cause. In English, not: cargo, nor a balance carried forward

sense_en: The relay
not_carried_en: Laozi 77. In English, not: a relay race, nor passing a message

sense_en: Overdetermination: made together, with no part making it alone
not_carried_en: In English, not: cooperation by agreement, nor fate

sense_en: The target above all others
not_carried_en: Laozi 67; neighbour of seeking without rest. In English, not: ambition, nor supremacy of a ruler

sense_en: A closed loop: what is handed back is less than what is received
not_carried_en: The Analects. In English, not: forbearance as a virtue, nor not retaliating by choice

sense_en: Bounded rule (`Within`): a rule accepted only within a formed boundary
not_carried_en: In English, not: a rule laid down by a ruler, nor a local law

sense_en: Held: a living claim lies in some standpoint's own region
not_carried_en: First proposed as 在己; Xunzi's sense of control in "what lies with oneself" is not taken. In English, not: possession by an owner, nor holding by hand

sense_en: J4, legitimate feasible choice
not_carried_en: 可得 names an option reachable in one step; the half on legitimacy has no name yet. In English, not: a chooser's free will, nor consumer choice

sense_en: The lifting rule L: every outcome better than every outcome
not_carried_en: A supposition. In English, not: raising by someone, nor lifting a ban

sense_en: Enough as a possibility
not_carried_en: In English, not: a chance someone takes

sense_en: Enough assured
not_carried_en: In English, not: an assurance given by someone, nor insurance

sense_en: WLPO
not_carried_en: In English, not: a knower who knows everything

sense_en: Markov's principle
not_carried_en: In English, not: anything of Markov chains or the Markov property

sense_en: Stability (not not q implies q)
not_carried_en: 稳 is not used. In English, not: stability of a dynamical system, nor steadiness of character

sense_en: A representation an account uses
not_carried_en: Kept apart from model and reading. In English, not: acting on behalf of someone, nor political representation

sense_en: Sufficient condition
not_carried_en: The first half of the Mohist definition of the major reason. In English, not: a cause acting as an agent

sense_en: Interleavings
not_carried_en: D43: the order of steps is a reading, derived from the relations only where every two exchanges share a relatum. In English, not: weaving by someone, nor a schedule someone chooses

sense_en: By a time limit, a source reaches the reader through couplings
not_carried_en: In English, not: a message sent by someone, nor arrival by travel

sense_en: Fixed parity only between the two ends
not_carried_en: Wang Bi; no deriving of places from honour and lowliness. In English, not: a phase of matter, nor a fixed stage of a plan

sense_en: The two halves (trigrams) of a hexagram
not_carried_en: Wang Bi. In English, not: shares divided between parties

sense_en: The amount a condition stands at a step (`Dependence.level`, a natural number)
not_carried_en: Not accumulation that only increases (a level can fall and run dry), not the cultivated sense of accumulating good, not an arithmetic product; height, the modern 水平 (evaluative) and amount are not taken. In English, not: a rank or standard (a high level), a flat surface, nor a level of consciousness

sense_en: A formation active at a step (`Dependence.active`, only a proposition, carrying no content)
not_carried_en: Takes Tianyun's contrast of moving and staying, without will or value; the mover posed in the same passage (a single centre) is not carried; fate, luck, destiny and transport are not carried; not written run, and kept apart from move, arising and conveying. In English, not: an action done by an agent, busyness, nor radioactivity

sense_en: The threshold amount a dependence requires (`Dependence.need`, a natural number)
not_carried_en: The sense of waiting is not carried; need names the threshold, an amount, not a thing (dependence names the relation, draws the drawing); the later sense "must, need to" is taken explicitly. In English, not: lack felt by someone, desire, nor poverty

sense_en: Total level: the sum of the levels of a finite family of conditions
not_carried_en: Not family level (the word family would repeat); the economic word stock and the reserve of `Web.Carries` are not taken; persists has its own name. In English, not: a stock of goods or shares, nor inventory owned

sense_en: Family: a finite list (Lean `List`) whose members may be relata, conditions, configurations or steps, read together
not_carried_en: The pre-Qin main senses of clan and kind, the nine generations of kin, extermination of a clan and nation, all kinship and social senses, are not carried; not a table; census keeps its name as one use of a family. In English, not: kinship or a household, nor a family of products

sense_en: History: any sequence of configurations and moves along the steps, whether or not some process allows it
not_carried_en: Calendar and calendrical numbers, history as a narrative of human affairs and personal experience are not carried; a sequence of values read off by itself is a course, not a history. In English, not: the discipline of history, nor a past remembered

sense_en: Rule: the value of the slow component of a two-level course, changed only at reading steps
not_carried_en: The sense of ritual measure and of admonition is not carried; the modern law of nature is not borrowed, so as not to mix with law; a rule is not a law: a change of rule changes the law. In English, not: a rule laid down by a ruler, a regulation, nor a measuring rule

sense_en: A condition stands at a step: its level is positive
not_carried_en: The cultivated evaluation of holding a store as not enough is not carried; standing as the status of a claim is another concept. In English, not: standing up, nor social standing

sense_en: Context: the bounds within which claims are shown; a context holds some claims and shows their values at each configuration
not_carried_en: The pre-Qin main senses of border and territory are not carried, nor the Buddhist object facing the senses (the subject/object dyad), the Yogacara "no objects", nor grades of spiritual realm; not linguistic context only. In English, not: a speaker's background, nor a setting chosen by someone

sense_en: Context-free: a claim carries no index of context, one value per claim
not_carried_en: Not the Yogacara "no objects", nor the boundless of Qiwulun (a cultivated realm). In English, not: context-free grammar

sense_en: A history that, twice at one configuration with one move, always leads to the same
not_carried_en: Not carried: Shun moving heaven and earth and the sage's punishments (a single centre), attaining the Way (an origin), the Odes' norms of conduct, Sunzi's unfailing victories; not single-minded loyalty. In English, not: logical consistency (freedom from contradiction), nor consistency of character

sense_en: Sub-process: every step of Q is a step of P
not_carried_en: 子 as in subset and subgroup, a convention; no offspring or kinship sense; not 體 (that would read as the substance of change). In English, not: a subroutine run by someone, nor a subordinate

sense_en: An eligible alternative that no eligible alternative is above in the given order
not_carried_en: There may be several, not compared with one another, not a unique extreme; above names only a position in the given order, without rank or better and worse; optimum and optimization are not taken. In English, not: the best, optimal, nor a maximum

sense_en: A formation that at each step, within its taking limit, takes a maximal outcome of its own order among those it can obtain
not_carried_en: Its order is its own, not the widening comparison, and carries no better or worse; optimizer is not taken. In English, not: a maximizer of welfare, nor a chooser with preferences

sense_en: The most a member may take from a condition across a step
not_carried_en: Names only the upper bound of taking; the bound on giving is another concept; capacity, strength and the single word limit are not taken; the cultivated sense of restraining desire is not carried. In English, not: ability or capability of an agent, nor a legal limit

sense_en: Net draw: up to a step a part has taken from a condition strictly more than it has given
not_carried_en: Net is an accounting word and is not taken; the scope (which part, up to which step, cumulative, at which condition) must be written. In English, not: taking more than one's due, nor greed

sense_en: Net give: up to a step a part has given a condition strictly more than it has taken
not_carried_en: Net is not taken, as for taking beyond giving. In English, not: generosity, nor charity

sense_en: What was given at the preceding step (second component of the adjusted state)
not_carried_en: Not 前與 (could be read as giving first); not the lag of the field test. In English, not: a previous gift

sense_en: From some step on the configuration does not change across any step
not_carried_en: Takes the change of transformation (change of configuration); not 居, 不改, 定 (collides with decided), coming to rest, stillness, nor "never returns". In English, not: settling a dispute, nor settling down

sense_en: Event: a formation at a step
not_carried_en: Not carried: the fate of "the course of destiny" in the same sentence, serving a lord, Xunzi's intended and profitable doing, the modern affairs and matters. In English, not: a happening with an agent, a social occasion, nor an event of probability theory

sense_en: How carriers stand to the others, compared by cross-multiplying
not_carried_en: Read lü; the ratio sense appears later (Han mathematics), with no pre-Qin source; leading, model and following one's nature are not carried; not market share. In English, not: a share of stock or ownership, nor a fair share

sense_en: A natural-number weight on each listed event
not_carried_en: A weighting gives a counting order, a supplied parameter, not an ethical order; ranking by widening is the widening comparison alone; the sense of importance and urgency and the Guanzi's monetary price technique are not carried. In English, not: importance, physical weight, nor the preference of a judge

sense_en: Region: a set of configurations or of formations given by a predicate
not_carried_en: The single centre of "the king dwells as one of them" is not carried, nor territory and the domain of a state; kept apart from world, context and family. In English, not: a geographic region, nor a domain owned

sense_en: What a step leads to: the configuration after a move, or the level obtainable after a step within a taking limit under balance
not_carried_en: The good and the military context of the same sentence, fruit, resolution and "indeed", and the Buddhist cause-and-effect and karmic retribution are not carried; inheritance does not pair with it as cause and effect. In English, not: a result someone aims at, nor a payoff

sense_en: A form occurs in a record: it was met on that occasion
not_carried_en: Not carried: the personal affairs of an encounter, the fortune of meeting or missing. In English, not: an event happening to someone

sense_en: A record offers a sense entry: it has this meaning among those available then
not_carried_en: Names only the relation of a record to a sense entry, not the giving of the flow nor assigning a value; bestowing and goods are not carried. In English, not: an offer made by a party, nor an offer for sale

sense_en: Price's selection term proper: concordance less discordance
not_carried_en: Not selection (a claim about level histories) nor selection through couplings; whether natural selection read by the selection term is selection through couplings is a conjecture. In English, not: a term of office, nor choosing by a chooser

sense_en: An order rising with a family: ranks above every outcome the family exceeds
not_carried_en: Above names only a position in the given order; not winning (the layer of contest). In English, not: a family rising in society

sense_en: Room beyond: an obtainable outcome higher beyond the family than another
not_carried_en: Kept apart from margin; it is a property of the set of obtainable outcomes, not a unit actually moving in; room to manoeuvre (financial) is not taken. In English, not: a room of a house, nor latitude granted by someone

sense_en: The observed inputs of a lumping
not_carried_en: The skill of Cook Ding and his meeting by spirit are not carried. In English, not: facts certified by an authority, nor a database

sense_en: The standing draw H of a regime, taken first at every step
not_carried_en: The constant way and the cardinal bonds are not carried. In English, not: a standing order someone gives, nor a lottery draw

sense_en: Run-dry boundary: H + y; a level starting below it runs dry, one starting above it does not fall below its start
not_carried_en: The 界 of division; the boundary of members has its own names (own region, boundary of a self) and a limit of allocation is footprint; not Xunzi's limit of distribution; replaces "point of no return"; kept apart from the break. In English, not: a dramatic point of no return, nor a border

sense_en: What is left of a condition after a prior draw (and others' exchange), before the part's own taking
not_carried_en: Not 所剩, 所余 or 所遗; the level after the step is the outcome, not what is left. In English, not: leftovers, nor an inheritance

sense_en: What lies beyond the ratio in a closed capture, read by neither selection nor reading
not_carried_en: Whether it is a loss is something significance says and Lean does not derive, so it is not named loss. In English, not: beyond reason, nor out of proportion
