sense_en: A bound of a level above and below which different things follow
not_carried_en: The ritual sense is not carried; the general name of such bounds: need, run-dry boundary and filling threshold have their own names; the break names the fall below a threshold, not the threshold itself. In English, not: a doorway, nor a threshold of perception

sense_en: Exact transmission in Price's sense: each offspring carries its parent's amount
not_carried_en: Names only exact passing; transmission (`Flow.TransmitsWithin`) is another structure. In English, not: faithful copying by a copyist

sense_en: A rule tilts toward the carriers: under it selection does not lower their ratio
not_carried_en: Names only direction, without partiality or favouritism; differs from one-sided response and a part withheld. In English, not: favour or preference of someone

sense_en: The claims a derivation starts from
not_carried_en: Han Fei's former kings and evaluation of deceit are not carried; kept apart from if (a local condition) and supposition; normative warrant is another concept. In English, not: a ground or foundation, nor a basis of authority

sense_en: Each taker takes no more than the step gives (`Flow.WithinOwn`)
not_carried_en: Its direction is the reverse of gainless; the takings together may still exceed the giving. In English, not: fairness among takers

sense_en: What all present take from a condition across a step (`Flow.taken`)
not_carried_en: Merge is not used for it. In English, not: a joint venture, nor sharing by agreement

sense_en: Under a standing draw, the function by which a condition gives according to what is left
not_carried_en: Standing means one function reading only what is left, not a constant giving (the giving varies with what is left); law of giving is not taken (a law is a determined process); regime (a social word) is not taken. In English, not: a political regime, nor a regular gift

sense_en: Scope of the ethics: whose losses count, everything whose continuation has significance
not_carried_en: Fixing it orders nothing; ordering is only in the widening comparison; the generic word scope is not taken. In English, not: concern of a mind, nor jurisdiction

sense_en: The end of a joint plan (the leaf constructor)
not_carried_en: Not carried: governing the leaves by the trunk (a single centre), the secondary sense of branches and leaves, and the generation sense. In English, not: a plant leaf, nor a page

sense_en: Footprint of a configuration: the things it treads on
not_carried_en: Its content is a supplied representation, not derived by a law; not carried: ritual as what people tread, the honour of "where the noble tread", the virtue of treading, and the cultivated sense of practice. In English, not: the print of a foot, nor a carbon footprint

sense_en: Connected valuation: every two living claims are linked by formed relations
not_carried_en: The spatial adjacency of Mati and its age of perfect virtue are not carried; kept apart from continuity, goes on and cross-situational standing. In English, not: social connections, nor topological connectedness beyond the linking

sense_en: A standpoint can intervene in a response
not_carried_en: Not carried: armour, uprightness, and the cultivated sense of the perfect man untouched by gain and loss; not what a part reaches, nor capability. In English, not: permission to enter, nor access rights

sense_en: Extension on a frame: keeps every realized claim and realizes one more living claim
not_carried_en: The four sprouts as an inherent nature and filling them out to protect the four seas are not carried; extension carries no "better", ranking lies only in the widening comparison. In English, not: an extension granted by someone, nor an extension of a building

sense_en: A supplied binary relation ranking alternatives, not necessarily total, additive or transitive
not_carried_en: Not carried: seniority, ranks of nobility (rank and contest), schools, and the Xugua title; sequences are histories, not orders. In English, not: a command, social order, nor orderliness

sense_en: A claim holds (is realized) at a configuration
not_carried_en: The function uses "then", "in that case" and "although" are not carried; holding is at one configuration; comes to be is across a step. In English, not: holding by hand, nor possession

sense_en: Strict loss match: each loss matched one-to-one with a loss of the same content, with one loss more on the other side
not_carried_en: Matching heaven, matching in honour, and marriage are not carried. In English, not: a match in sport, nor compensation

sense_en: Assured completion of a plan: every move available, every successor safe, every end meets the target
not_carried_en: Kept apart from assured enough; 至 as in completes only by running. In English, not: a guarantee given by someone

sense_en: The tier counted first in a two-tier comparison
not_carried_en: Not carried: noble and base, the single centre of lords and kings, and "the upper rests on the base": counting the basic first is a supplied order (J1/J2, supposition), not derived from dependence. In English, not: a lower class, nor a foundation

sense_en: A claim a configuration does not realize (that another does)
not_carried_en: Funeral and the loss of a state are not carried; what a cut loses and the loss of training are other concepts. In English, not: grief, financial loss, nor a loss to an owner

sense_en: A standpoint has a contributory reason in a response
not_carried_en: A reason is not an obligation and not a ranking, and predicts no recognition or compliance; the funeral context is not carried; the motive sense is not taken. In English, not: a motive, reason as a faculty, nor a cause

sense_en: Every due undertaking is done or released
not_carried_en: Prisoners and punishment, the Buddhists and relief are not carried. In English, not: an electrical discharge, nor dismissal

sense_en: One flow takes no more and gives no less than another at every step and condition
not_carried_en: Only a relation between two flows, not a virtue of a thing; the three treasures, compassion, "not daring to be first" and household thrift (financial) are not carried; its ranking is a consequence of the widening comparison, not a value of restraint. In English, not: self-control, nor physical or legal restraint

sense_en: A number per alternative, ranking by size (natural-number or bounded)
not_carried_en: Law, institution and fixed numbers, and guessing are not carried. In English, not: a game score, nor a grade

sense_en: A predicate on configurations a seeking is toward, met or not by a configuration
not_carried_en: Desire and wanting (psychological) and Xunzi's approval of the mind as the standard (a single centre) are not carried. In English, not: an aim of an agent, nor a military target

sense_en: An idle step of a reading of steps (stuttering)
not_carried_en: Not carried: the gentleman as the summation of the way (a single centre), the evaluation of neglecting duty, wilderness and broad-mindedness. In English, not: laziness, nor a wasted step

sense_en: The continuation a balanced world's relations induce: f after the step balance-continues g before it
not_carried_en: Not "conserving continuation" (renewing has its own name, and conserving is another structure). In English, not: continued by effort, nor a balanced budget carried over

sense_en: Something holds at arbitrarily late steps
not_carried_en: The hatred and the theme of ruling the world in the same sentence are not carried; pre-Qin 屢 says only "again and again"; "no last time" is this edition's convention; it gives no bound of frequency or interval. In English, not: repetition by habit

sense_en: Ceasing under a continuation: active before the step and continued by nothing after it
not_carried_en: Not 已而无续, 续绝, 续止, 续尽, nor 无后 (no heirs, a kinship sense). In English, not: dying without heirs

sense_en: Each maximal selector takes a maximal outcome given what the others do
not_carried_en: Mutual says only "each given what the others do", without affinity, and is not to be read as the selectors being incomparable with one another. In English, not: mutual benefit, nor agreement

sense_en: A quantity read from the configuration is larger at the next step than at this one
not_carried_en: Now names only this step, without the sense of present against past; kept apart from more without end. In English, not: greed, nor ambition

sense_en: Amounts: an addition with an order it keeps and cancels
not_carried_en: Not carried: comparing noble and base, measuring instruments, magnanimity, evaluating ability for office, the Buddhist means of knowledge and "immeasurable"; the verb is not a name. In English, not: a sum of money, nor a large quantity

sense_en: A value of each configuration (a function on configurations), read, learned or predicted
not_carried_en: Value in the function sense, a convention; carries no worth or rank and is kept apart from valuation; feature is not taken (its character names verification). In English, not: worth, nor value as importance

sense_en: An event within renewal at a step: active, and every dependence on the conditions it takes part in is kept
not_carried_en: It cannot be read as belonging to a renewing stretch: the converse fails (`Preemption.renewingAt_consuming_narrows`). In English, not: within a renewal period of a contract

sense_en: Some course of moves leads to it
not_carried_en: The desire, heaven and mind of the same passage are not carried. In English, not: possession, nor being deceived

sense_en: The present of a kept history (its first component)
not_carried_en: Love and benefit in the same text are not carried; not the opening particles, nor this step in general. In English, not: a gift, presence of a person, nor the experienced now

sense_en: A formation carries a pattern at a step
not_carried_en: A pattern is not a thing besides its carriers: it is given only by which formation carries it when; "no blame" is not carried; kept apart from reserve and carried amount. In English, not: transport, nor a carrier company

sense_en: Across one step a carrier passes the pattern to a carrier of the next step
not_carried_en: Ruler and minister and the true ruler (a single centre) are not carried; kept apart from transmission and succession. In English, not: passing by, nor dying

sense_en: Determined up to likeness at a configuration: any two outcomes of one move are alike
not_carried_en: 定 is not used for determined. In English, not: determination of will

sense_en: A configuration of six lines from the bottom up (sixty-four in all)
not_carried_en: Not carried: divination, fortune of hexagram statements, hexagram virtues, hexagram qi; the three powers and the virtues of humaneness and rightness; the origin "the Changes have the great ultimate". In English, not: a mystic symbol, nor a six-pointed star

sense_en: A place of a hexagram with its value, firm or yielding
not_carried_en: Not carried: the moving lines of divination, the fortune of line statements, yin and yang, the divining stalks, the change of the Xici. In English, not: a line of text, nor a queue

sense_en: The hexagram with every line turned into its opposite
not_carried_en: Error and mixture are not carried; "interweaving the numbers" is about numbers (scope). In English, not: a compliment, nor something completing another

sense_en: The rank of a place within its trigram: low, middle, high
not_carried_en: Evaluation of high and low, loftiness, honour and lowliness are not carried; it is used only as this noun, never as a comparison. In English, not: stature, nor eminence

sense_en: The hexagram turned upside down
not_carried_en: Overthrow and destruction, the ill fortune of the cauldron line, and the ruler and people as boat and water (a single centre) are not carried. In English, not: turnover of money or staff

sense_en: Between two adjacent places (five in all)
not_carried_en: Not carried: occasion, social intercourse, reality and suchness (Buddhist), limits before and after, margins (the boundary of a self has its own name); heaven and earth are not read as two origins; kept apart from juncture. In English, not: a sewn seam, nor a coal seam

sense_en: The law of waxing and waning on hexagrams
not_carried_en: Hexagram qi, monthly ordinances and the evaluations of the waxing and waning of gentleman and petty man are not carried; not a loop of couplings; not census balance. In English, not: phases of the moon

sense_en: An exchange touches a relatum: the relatum takes part in it
not_carried_en: Carries no direction or amount; the Buddhist contact (union of sense, object and consciousness) and offending are not carried. In English, not: physical contact, nor emotional touching

sense_en: A configuration can be reached from another by a finite course of admissible moves, zero steps included
not_carried_en: The court context of ruler and minister is not carried. In English, not: reaching out by an agent, nor range

sense_en: Downstream along a chain of level couplings
not_carried_en: The modern sense of upstream and downstream industries and the evaluation of striving upstream are not carried. In English, not: a river only, nor a lower status

sense_en: Two level histories alike through a formation's couplings at a step or up to a step
not_carried_en: The bodily sense of the heavenly organs, the mind as single centre of verified knowing, and dependent origination are not carried; not 无别 (别 names bounded significance). In English, not: looking alike to an observer

sense_en: A run adheres to a reading: every finite stretch of it is a stretch of some run in the reading
not_carried_en: Vassalage, attachment and allegiance (social), far-fetched association and the military context are not carried. In English, not: adhesion by glue, nor loyalty

sense_en: A finite stretch shows a run is not in a reading
not_carried_en: Pairs with verification; the pre-Qin sense of mixed and impure is not carried; the refuting sense is later. In English, not: a rebuttal by an opponent

sense_en: Common response: an answer admissible and completing to the target from every configuration in doubt
not_carried_en: Not responds to (a law responding to a level); countermeasure, relative, right and wrong and pairing are not carried. In English, not: a reply by a speaker, nor a consensus

sense_en: An evidence item: whether it bears on a name and which sense entries it offers
not_carried_en: Official business of granting office and rewarding merit, registers and employment are not carried; prefix is the whole segment, a record is one item. In English, not: a document kept by an archivist, a sports record, nor a disc

sense_en: A yes or no guess at each horizon of each run
not_carried_en: Han Fei's technique of the ruler (single centre, contest), occult arts, mind-technique and humane technique are not carried. In English, not: a practitioner's methodology

sense_en: A method verifies a reading in the limit: the reading holds exactly on the runs where the method answers yes from some step on
not_carried_en: The evaluation of the utmost, the great ultimate and the royal ultimate (origin and centre) are not carried. In English, not: confirmation by an authority

sense_en: What a form names in a code (one name may offer several)
not_carried_en: 义 only in the sense of meaning; righteousness and the right against profit are not carried. In English, not: a sense organ, nor good sense

sense_en: Right at a step: the extrapolation gives exactly the value that comes
not_carried_en: Gain and loss of interest, attaining the Way and self-satisfaction are not carried; the other names built with 得 are not borrowed. In English, not: striking, nor a success of an agent

sense_en: Renaming: a re-identification the same at every step
not_carried_en: Xunzi's making new names is coining, not renaming. In English, not: renaming by an authority

sense_en: Before some step a run was at a configuration and its move was this move
not_carried_en: No will of choice: the taking of a run has no chooser, only the move it made; literary grace and fiefs, and the mind as centre, are not carried. In English, not: a choice, nor taking possession

sense_en: A map from sense entries to names that each formation holds
not_carried_en: Modern, with no pre-Qin source (taken from encoding); chips, prices and numbers are not carried. In English, not: a legal code, program source code, nor a secret code

sense_en: A hearer takes, per the adoption rule, the name a speaker gives a sense entry
not_carried_en: The evaluation "abandoning virtue", the official hearing of government and lawsuits, and obedience are not carried; kept apart from observation. In English, not: a court hearing, nor auditory perception

sense_en: A group formed from the previous group across a step
not_carried_en: The change of dynasties and the evaluation "I follow Zhou" are not carried; differs from keeps pace. In English, not: a military unit, nor an age group of persons

sense_en: Origin of a name along an order of hearing: the formation it traces back to
not_carried_en: Divination of auspicious and inauspicious and the context of order and disorder are not carried; source is not taken (it reads as an origin-ground). In English, not: an origin as a ground, nor ownership history

sense_en: The envelope is nonempty and outside every admitted fault set there is a supporting witness
not_carried_en: The evaluation of settling right and wrong and the authority of scripture are not carried, nor bullying the weak (contest); tallies and contracts (financial) are not taken. In English, not: a diploma, nor a share certificate

sense_en: A function on configurations whose value a reading gives or an extrapolation predicts
not_carried_en: No pre-Qin source, a convention; 征 here is a sign, not verification; data is written what is seen. In English, not: a salient trait, nor a newspaper feature

sense_en: A finite inquiry tree: ask a move and branch on the value shown, or answer, or abort
not_carried_en: The enemy situation, contest and government policy are not carried; belief is written what is in doubt. In English, not: a policy of a government or insurer, nor a strategy

sense_en: A law of exchange reads, for each formation outside the part, through its couplings
not_carried_en: Not "reads via couplings" (two names for one sense). In English, not: reading a text

sense_en: A model as the class of level histories it admits
not_carried_en: The Mencius line shows only the sense of permitting. In English, not: permission by an authority

sense_en: A state and a rule: the rule tilts toward the carriers and is not above what the ratio reads
not_carried_en: Not immobility: ratio and rule can still rise, what cannot happen is turning; the attachment of the mind (a single centre and a verdict on debaters), glue and lacquer, and stubborn rigidity are not carried. In English, not: locked by a key, nor lock-in (named separately)

sense_en: Activity of a run toward a target
not_carried_en: Seeking is not an entity in Lean; the seeker is not derived; Xunzi's desire and the norms of moderating seeking, Mencius' cultivation and fate are not carried. In English, not: desire, nor searching with intent

sense_en: o is coupled by level, besides its own, to every condition coupling into a
not_carried_en: A coupling relation, not a new thing; not "borrowed coupling". In English, not: mind-reading, nor reading someone's letters

sense_en: Gap between two amounts: what either has beyond the other, without direction
not_carried_en: Read cha; ranks of seniority and of high and low (rank layer), error and unevenness, and the modern evaluative "poor" are not carried; distance is one use of gap, not another name. In English, not: a gap in knowledge, nor a generation gap

sense_en: One map in the list whose composition is the return map
not_carried_en: 节 is the joint between bones, not the stretch between joints; not measure or restraint. In English, not: a chain link, nor a web link

sense_en: One turn around a loop: one application of the return map
not_carried_en: Siege and surrounding are not carried. In English, not: a turn in a game, nor a turn of mind

sense_en: Factor of a link: the integer by which it multiplies the difference it receives
not_carried_en: Turning one's back and market prices are not carried. In English, not: a contributing cause, nor an agent in trade

sense_en: The order of an expansion of the carried amount by the number of responses composed
not_carried_en: Rank, official grade and class are not carried: it counts composed responses and ranks nothing. In English, not: a command, nor social rank

sense_en: Polynomial bound in the steps
not_carried_en: A modern mathematical name, a convention. In English, not: anything beyond the stated bound

sense_en: Rule of regulation at one condition: from the record of the rest, what it gives and takes at each step
not_carried_en: The relay is not a response function; the normative sense of "ought" is not carried. In English, not: an answer of a person

sense_en: The law read as if the marked stock stood at its threshold
not_carried_en: Not "standing law" (standing names other things) nor "unending law". In English, not: a law before a revolution

sense_en: Joint exchange at a condition: all that is taken and all that is given at a step
not_carried_en: Not merge, not conjunction. In English, not: trade between parties

sense_en: A formation present in the flow at a step
not_carried_en: Sacrifice and spirits are not carried; not persists, activity, census or participation (those present but neither taking nor giving may be inactive); no hierarchy of presence. In English, not: participation by choice, nor attendance

sense_en: A relatum descending from a giver
not_carried_en: Death and entering are not carried; parent and child, descendants and kinship are not carried (descent is not limited to kin). In English, not: children of persons

sense_en: Listed generations: a first family, the offspring of each member forming the next
not_carried_en: Hereditary office, era and world are not carried. In English, not: kin, nor a generation of people

sense_en: Mean of a family's amount: total over size, compared only by cross-multiplying
not_carried_en: Distribution and fairness, natural equalizing, balance of force and equality of status are not carried. In English, not: unkindness, nor the mean as a virtue

sense_en: A group of a family listed group by group; within-group and among-group
not_carried_en: A modern statistical convention; ribbons and weaving, offices and military units are not carried; not family, collective, lumping class or footprint. In English, not: a social group, nor a group of algebra

sense_en: The giving of a waits on the giving of b at the step before
not_carried_en: The ritual of a ruler's summons, the gentleman as centre and awaiting fate are not carried; not dependence. In English, not: waiting with patience, nor serving at table

sense_en: Whole of given parts: active at each step exactly where some part is active
not_carried_en: Parts given by a predicate, not necessarily a finite family; whole alone names everything of the unfolding. In English, not: a totality above its parts, nor an organism with a will

sense_en: Course: the values of a history's configurations through a model, step by step; every sequence of values is a course, its configurations and law read off it
not_carried_en: There is no legislator outside the course; not carried: ornament, literary grace, civil virtue and governance, posthumous titles, cultivating the world by culture, pattern as ornament over substance (nothing lies beneath a course), astrology, writing and characters, and fortune. In English, not: a course of study, a route chosen by someone, nor a meal

sense_en: Same course through a model under a law: the courses of two configurations are equal at every step
not_carried_en: Not "same writing" (the imposed code of unifying script); only under a law through a model. In English, not: agreement of opinion
